title: Passing the Time Until GTA6: Why This Horror Game Is a Great Fit
description: As we wait for GTA6, finding a short, engaging game to play is tough. Discover how one editor found the perfect 10-hour horror palette cleanser.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Finding the Right Game While Waiting for GTA6

With massive titles like The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time and the highly anticipated GTA 6 looming on the horizon, many gamers find themselves hesitant to dive into a sprawling epic that demands a serious time investment. Starting a massive open-world adventure right before a major industry shift can feel like a daunting commitment.

Recently, Push Square editor Liam shared a refreshing perspective on how to tackle this pre-launch gaming limbo. Despite having no prior experience with the Hellraiser film franchise, he decided to give the AA horror title Hellraiser: Revival a spin—and was pleasantly surprised by the results.

## The Appeal of a 10-Hour Palate Cleanser

For players looking to pass the time without getting sucked into a hundred-hour campaign, game length matters. According to the experience shared by the outlet, Hellraiser: Revival offers a tightly paced roughly 10-hour playthrough that easily accommodates completionists, culminating in the earning of its Platinum Trophy.

This kind of focused, bite-sized experience serves as an ideal bridge for gamers who are currently saving their stamina and attention spans for the colossal time sinks that games like GTA 6 are expected to be.

## Why AA Horror Games Stand Out

While AA horror titles may not boast the astronomical budgets or multi-year hype cycles of Rockstar's upcoming blockbuster, they often excel by delivering focused, undiluted entertainment. They don't require deep lore diving or endless grinding, allowing players to jump straight into the action and enjoy a complete, satisfying arc in a single weekend.

## Editor's Take

In the countdown to GTA 6, forcing yourself through a massive RPG or open-world game can feel like a chore. Tucked-away AA experiences like Hellraiser: Revival prove that you don't need a massive time commitment to have fun. Sometimes, a tight 10-hour horror ride is exactly what you need.
